hints.title: Distinct Digits Sum Obstacle
hints.text: Finding combinations of k distinct digits from 1 through 9 that sum to n requires strict size and total constraints. How can ascending selection avoid permutations and prune branches exceeding the target?

hints.title: Strict Ascending Digits Invariant
hints.text: Only pick candidate digits strictly greater than the previously picked digit to guarantee distinct digits in ascending order without duplicate combinations.

hints.title: Target Reduction Backtracking Procedure
hints.text: Start at digit 1. At each step, if path length equals k and target remaining equals 0, record path. Loop digit d from start to 9. If d exceeds remaining target, break. Append d, recurse with start = d + 1, k, and remaining target - d, then pop.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Search space is bounded by (9 choose k) <= 126 configurations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through full powersets generates invalid lengths and duplicate orderings.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Path buffer of size k requires O(k) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pruning early when candidate digit exceeds remaining target.
